en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਲਖ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀ ਸੋਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaam lakh kar kaamanaa bahu roopee sohai|

en.bdb: Passionate urges in the form of lacs of desires may appear in many forms.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਕਰੋਪ ਕਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਹੁਇ ਜੋਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh karop karodh kar dhusaman hui johai|

en.bdb: Lacs of enemies may stare in anger; temptations in lacs and lacs of mammons may inveigle and deceive;

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲੋਭ ਲਖ ਲਖਮੀ ਹੁਇ ਧੋਹਣ ਧੋਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lobh lakh lakhamee hui dhohan dhohai|

en.bdb: Maya and infatuation pretending to be virtuous may in crores of ways adorne(the world);

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰੋੜ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਇ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸੋਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: maiaa moh karoR mil hui bahu gun sohai|

en.bdb: And ego, full of pride for having killed lacs of demons, may touch a gursikh;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਲਖ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: asur sa(n)ghaar ha(n)kaar lakh haumai kar chhohai|

en.bdb: But to the Sikh of the Guru, who listens to the teachings of the Guru in the holy congregation,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sikh sun gur sikh na pohai ||1||

en.bdb: They all cannot affect the least.
